title: Reflection atlas leaks 7 texture RIDs: color_views and color_buffer
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.7.1.stable, master (00932449c9)
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.stable

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v4.6.stable / v4.7.1.stable / master (00932449c9) - Vulkan 1.4.349 - AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT

### Issue description

In ReflectionAtlas (servers\rendering\renderer_rd\storage_rd\light_storage.h:257) 3 RID's: color_views, color_buffer & color_fbs are not released ightStorage::_reflection_atlas_clear.
This leads to objects leaks reported in terminal:
``` bash
PS C:\work\godot-reflection-probe-rid-leak> godot --path .
Godot Engine v4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.349 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT

WARNING: 7 RIDs of type "Texture" were leaked.
   at: finalize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:8900)
```

Error occurs once per **ReflectionProbe**.

Error exist in Forward+ & Forward Mobile renderer.

Fix:
In LightStorage::_reflection_atlas_clear add release objects:

``` diff
--- a/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/light_storage.cpp
+++ b/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/light_storage.cpp
@@ -1557,6 +1557,17 @@ void LightStorage::_reflection_atlas_clear(ReflectionAtlas *p_reflection_atlas)
        RD::get_singleton()->free_rid(p_reflection_atlas->reflection);
        p_reflection_atlas->reflection = RID();
 
+       for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
+               RD::get_singleton()->free_rid(p_reflection_atlas->color_fbs[i]);
+               p_reflection_atlas->color_fbs[i] = RID();
+
+               RD::get_singleton()->free_rid(p_reflection_atlas->color_views[i]);
+               p_reflection_atlas->color_views[i] = RID();
+       }
+
+       RD::get_singleton()->free_rid(p_reflection_atlas->color_buffer);
+       p_reflection_atlas->color_buffer = RID();
+
        RD::get_singleton()->free_rid(p_reflection_atlas->depth_fb);
        p_reflection_atlas->depth_fb = RID();
```


### Steps to reproduce

Create new project with Forward+ or Mobile renderer.
Add Node3D with Camera3D and **ReflectionProbe**.
Run and close


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-reflection-probe-rid-leak-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31138844/godot-reflection-probe-rid-leak-mrp.zip)
